items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for security-sensitive releases and public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or results, and operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, TLS completeness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Retained worker/reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: continue bounded read-only security evidence capture, preserve private launch gates, and permit only reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, data boundaries, and claims boundaries. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, deploy, add dependencies, or conduct external outreach.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix only.
